# 苏宏助为 · Skills Hub

> 苏州苏宏助为智能科技有限公司维护 XRain 与 XRain Workforce；本仓是官方 AI 技能、专题参考与 CLI 的公开分发源。

按当前任务读取所需技能与参考。取得技能时复制完整目录，保持相对路径；安装和主动更新取默认分支，已安装副本不自动更新。平台核心源码保持闭源，实际平台调用使用获准环境和身份。

XRain 支持新业务建模，也支持对管理完善的已有系统直接通过业务编排转接接口，无需新增业务数据模型。Workforce 提供人与 AI 协作入口。SDK 是应用代码开发包，Skill 是 AI 任务方法，CLI 是终端工具；SDK 通过项目制品渠道交付，不应假定公共 npm 可匿名安装。技能元数据保留公司、来源、官方文档与关联产品。

## 产品、开发者与联系

- [产品与技术](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/products/index.md)：产品定位、公司归属与开发工具关系。
- [XRain](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/products/xrain.md)：业务应用、建模、编排和接口集成。
- [XRain Workforce](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/products/workforce.md)：人与 AI 的沟通、协作与业务工具。
- [官方开发者文档](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/developers/index.md)：从接入路线到 SDK、API、CLI 和示例。
- [免建模的接口编排](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/developers/integration.md)：原系统保持数据与规则，编排提供统一业务接口。
- [SDK 入门](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/developers/sdk.md)：取得、版本、完整读取示例与工具接入。
- [官方 AI 技能](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/developers/skills.md)：技能选择、归属、安装和更新。
- [联系我们](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/contact.md)：统一业务咨询、合作与 SDK 接入联系方式。

## 公司、课程与 AI 开发

- [企业解决方案与合作](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/solutions.md)：服务场景、交付范围和咨询方式。
- [人员学习](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/learn.md)：团队成员、企业开发者与合作伙伴的学习路线。
- [AI 开发入口](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/ai/index.md)：按业务需求连接技能、接口与示例。
- [平台能力与扩展选择](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/ai/platform.md)：模型、业务服务、页面、工具与现有系统的选择。
- [从需求到可验证结果](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/ai/development.md)：开发顺序、公开包导出与验证方法。
- [完整便签案例](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/ai/note-case.md)：完整输入、记录读写、权限与保留原数据升级。
- [全部专题目录](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/ai/reference.md)：业务参考、接口、CLI 和完整技能。
- [错误与当前环境](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/text/ai/troubleshooting.md)：版本、身份、失败及未验证条件。
- [统一文本索引](https://xingshukeji.github.io/xrainTrain/llms.txt)：本站课程与 AI 指南的全部 Markdown 入口。

## 完整技能入口

<!-- skills:start -->
- [shzw-aiinfra-adoption](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-aiinfra-adoption/SKILL.md)：Use when an existing XRain or other .NET app should consume LLM_backend_packages / AiInfra.Abp.* instead of rebuilding shared infrastructure. Trigger for overlap audits or migrations involving DI, UoW, data access, query/runtime records, permissions, RBAC/ABAC, audit, object projection, providers, package feeds, Storage, RAG, or ChatHub.
- [shzw-aiinfra-project-init](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-aiinfra-project-init/SKILL.md)：Use when creating a new greenfield .NET backend with LLM_backend_packages / AiInfra.Abp.*. Trigger for choosing the simple-api or layered-api scaffold, running the AiInfra scaffold CLI, wiring PostgreSQL and modules, validating package references, or adding the minimal workspace start/verify entry. Use shzw-aiinfra-adoption for an existing codebase.
- [shzw-align-solution-direction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-align-solution-direction/SKILL.md)：Align a requested solution direction or resolve a material uncertainty about outcome, boundary, ownership, invariants or completion. Use when competing interpretations or conflicting evidence could change those decisions. Clear routine implementation needs only a brief direction check, without loading this full method. Independently check user and agent premises, missing variables, costs, and reasoning bias.
- [shzw-audit-learning-content](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-audit-learning-content/SKILL.md)：Audit, write or restructure self-study tutorials, textbooks, courses, learning paths and educational visuals for correctness, depth, navigation, duplication and information density. Use for 教程、课件、学习路线、自学、初学者、内容太浅或重复、可跳读、图解教学 and learner-facing content reviews. Exclude ordinary code docs, API references, release notes, pure copyediting and bug fixes unless instructional design is also requested.
- [shzw-autonomous-project-decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-autonomous-project-decisions/SKILL.md)：用户跨项目默认处置政策。执行研发、测试、部署运维或文档任务时，遇到账号创建与复用、临时凭据、同目标修复复测、端口占用、依赖失败、兼容限制、资源清理或重复流程确认，按具体默认选择自主继续；仅对超出政策的实质影响升级决定。
- [shzw-backend-detailed-testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-backend-detailed-testing/SKILL.md)：Use for backend test evidence within a user-defined Development task, or as a scoped layer of an explicitly requested SystemTest task. Trigger for unit, integration, contract, isolated real-database, minimal real-host, smoke, missing coverage, or escaped regressions; choose the task type from the user's goal, never from the test technique or suite size.
- [shzw-backend-realdb-api-testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-backend-realdb-api-testing/SKILL.md)：Use when a user-defined Development task or explicitly requested SystemTest task needs assertion-backed backend API evidence against an isolated real database rather than mocks. Trigger for provider/schema/transaction behavior, response plus side-effect checks, or escaped production bugs; never infer the task type, a broad campaign, or deployment from use of a real database.
- [shzw-challenge-solution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-challenge-solution/SKILL.md)：Use only when the user asks to challenge, rebut, stress-test or find flaws in an existing solution, architecture, migration, implementation or governance proposal. Review that exact artifact read-only for unsupported assumptions, scope expansion, ownership mistakes, missing evidence and avoidable complexity. Recommend the next step without rewriting, executing, persisting or treating the review as approval.
- [shzw-cicd](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-cicd/SKILL.md)：查询、触发已有 Jenkins 流水线并跟踪构建、发布或部署；不编写流水线。
- [shzw-client-application-development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-client-application-development/SKILL.md)：Guide fast, bounded development of desktop, launcher, updater, native, mobile, and web clients. Use for Chinese requests about 技术选型、开发客户端、安装包、更新、版本、发布、签名、回滚、OSS or similar client delivery work. Keep reusable method rules here; load platform, distribution, and managed-runtime variants from references only when the request needs them.
- [shzw-code-boundary-governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-code-boundary-governance/SKILL.md)：Use when reviewing or changing backend Repository, Manager, AppService, Controller, Endpoint, DI, Application.Contracts, data-access, or provider boundaries. Trigger for architecture reviews, refactors, dependency-injection issues, AiInfra-versus-app ownership, XRain runtime/metadata paths, or suspected duplicated shared infrastructure.
- [shzw-develop-managed-client-capability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-develop-managed-client-capability/SKILL.md)：Develop, debug, upgrade, package, release or review trusted application-managed client capabilities. Use when the application owns an internal extension’s executable, version, health, resources, lifecycle, tool declarations, artifacts, delivery, update UX or validation. Covers technology selection, doctor checks, installers, OSS distribution and official updates. Exclude ordinary app features, arbitrary third-party drop-ins, manager-only UI and unrelated installer work.
- [shzw-document-governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-document-governance/SKILL.md)：Use for document governance, 文档治理, controlled technical writing when creating or materially revising workspace documents, user-controlled task execution-type and activity-plan alignment, AGENTS/Workflow/StructureContract control planes, deleting absorbed process documents or reports, reducing prompt hot paths, classifying document Kind, or aligning TASK_CONTROL with current facts.
- [shzw-engineering-boundaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-engineering-boundaries/SKILL.md)：审查并收敛工程职责、反复缺陷、文件消费边界、自建工具链和环境差异。用于复杂代码反复修补、历史热点审查、工程简化和跨层机制评审，以及新增启动、依赖、缓存、恢复或交付机制前的必要性判断；局部业务修改不触发整仓审计。
- [shzw-evolve-document-driven-workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-evolve-document-driven-workflow/SKILL.md)：Evolve workspace governance from a requested workflow improvement or a durable future-facing agent/process correction such as 以后必须、一律、统一、不要再. Distinguish discussion from authorized implementation by user intent and scope, not message count. Keep one-off product requirements local.
- [shzw-git-closeout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-git-closeout/SKILL.md)：Use automatically after one independent task has a passing conclusion, required activity cleanup is finished, and file changes can be attributed exactly. Runs the only add/commit/fetch/push path in a child process, preserves unrelated changes, reports Git separately, and never treats a commit or push as SystemTest evidence or Deployment authorization.
- [shzw-human-documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-human-documentation/SKILL.md)：规划、创建、改写或审阅面向人的中文开发文档时使用，包括单一人类文档入口、上手指南、日常开发闭环、系统测试指南、README，以及要求真实前置条件、明确值、无占位符、可观察结果和短步骤的发布、安装或部署指南；必须分开 Development、SystemTest、Deployment，不用于 ProductContract、CurrentDesign、Workflow、Runbook、AGENTS 或单纯的代码解释。
- [shzw-integrate-workforce-application](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-integrate-workforce-application/SKILL.md)：在 XRain Workforce 开发环境将独立应用接入应用中心，或修复已有接入时使用。按既有配置完成独立应用身份、统一登录、目录贡献、启动与真实验证。普通页面修改、仅查看应用列表及正式部署不触发此技能。
- [shzw-release-deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-release-deployment/SKILL.md)：Govern or execute an explicitly authorized Deployment of one approved artifact to one named target with verified admission evidence, rollback, and minimal post-deployment checks. Use for formal package publication, environment migration, release, rollout, cutover, rollback, or other target-environment changes; never trigger from development completion, test success, Git push, or artifact creation alone.
- [shzw-replicate-workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-replicate-workspace/SKILL.md)：Use when initializing or repairing a document-driven workspace control plane and its grounded human entry from an existing AGENTS.md/TASK_CONTROL/StructureContract/Workflow model. Trigger for 复刻工作空间, 初始化工作空间, 文档驱动开发, dual documentation surfaces, or control-plane upgrades. Do not infer product design, stack, APIs, source skeletons, services, or implementation directories.
- [shzw-runtime-stability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-runtime-stability/SKILL.md)：为运行稳定性调查、资源释放审查及负载、长时间运行、故障恢复验证选择场景、指标和判定依据。用于内存持续增长、容量与延迟、积压、取消、生命周期及依赖故障；不因一次部署或普通局部修改自动展开全套测试。
- [shzw-service-starter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-service-starter/SKILL.md)：Use when starting, stopping, restarting, checking, diagnosing, building, or locally verifying workspace services through root package.json scripts for a user-defined Development task or explicitly requested SystemTest task. Trigger for XRain or standalone frontend operations; formal publication, target migration, rollout, cutover, and rollback route to shzw-release-deployment instead.
- [shzw-system-testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-system-testing/SKILL.md)：Run or govern a SystemTest task only when the user explicitly asks for an independent integration, system, full-suite, candidate-acceptance, release-gate, or regression result against existing code. Choose control strength and persistence independently; never infer authority from a candidate list, CI, a release gate, test tooling, or suite size.
- [shzw-technical-solution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-technical-solution/SKILL.md)：Produce a requested technical solution or the working plan for a controlled technical change under WF-0002. Preserve the established direction and proceed within explicit implementation authorization. Ordinary implementation does not require this skill. Explicit solution-artifact requests and read-only discussion retain their own delivery boundaries.
- [shzw-upgrade-dsh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-upgrade-dsh/SKILL.md)：用户主动调用的 DSH 升级评估与实施：盘点包、复制源码、插件协议和外部 Runtime，分析上游差异，在升级过程中验证受影响行为。不自动触发，不等待上线前。
- [shzw-verify-workforce-composition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-verify-workforce-composition/SKILL.md)：在 XRain Workforce 开发、修复或验收插件装配、重组、裁剪、门户组合及其生命周期时使用。执行依赖组合矩阵，并通过内置浏览器真实登录和业务操作核验；不以构建、模块注册或测试数量代替用户功能证据。
- [shzw-workforce-agent-troubleshoot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-agent-troubleshoot/SKILL.md)：排查 Workforce 智能体不回复、不跟进、工具失败、重复消息、会话混淆和接管后迟到写入。
- [shzw-workforce-business-development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/SKILL.md)：基于 XRain 与 Workforce 落地企业业务，按现状选择免建模的接口编排、新业务建模或混合接入，再完成所需授权、逻辑、页面与智能体工具。
- [shzw-workforce-business-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-review/SKILL.md)：审查 XRain Workforce 的业务实现、工程职责与退役影响。按当前成员与租户、消息与 AI、Task、应用组合、业务资料和启动交付定位正式规则、真实入口、源码及验证证据。用于平台 review 和修复收口；局部问题只检查受影响业务链。
- [shzw-workforce-runtime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-runtime/SKILL.md)：启动、恢复和验收 Workforce 环境，核对部署效果，定位慢页面、慢登录、慢会话及实例资源增长。
- [shzw-xrain-access-diagnosis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-access-diagnosis/SKILL.md)：排查 XRain 登录后的 403、应用准入、角色与数据范围、执行身份和机器人权限；支持授权修复与撤权复测。
- [shzw-xrain-app-operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-app-operations/SKILL.md)：处理 XRain 已发布应用的租户安装、升级、冲突、中断恢复、组件恢复和卸载；不构建服务镜像。
- [shzw-xrain-app-package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-app-package/SKILL.md)：在任意项目编写和离线校验 XRain .appkg 应用源码与制品，使用目标提供的统一构建端点生成服务端制品，并按明确授权导入、安装和恢复应用。不用于部署 XRain 服务镜像或任意程序二进制。
- [shzw-xrain-auth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-auth/SKILL.md)：通过 XRain 认证中心网页准备或恢复固定身份、激活登录、修复 OIDC 接入，并验证原应用登录。
- [shzw-xrain-business-user-lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-business-user-lifecycle/SKILL.md)：在 XRain/Workforce 落地业务人员接入、实际使用、协作与职责变更的完整业务主线，连接固定身份、租户成员、应用准入、业务授权和持续维护。单独登录、403 或权限定位使用对应诊断能力。
- [shzw-xrain-cli](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-cli/SKILL.md)：用自带 CLI 连接 XRain 平台或应用市场，操作平台用户、权限、数据及应用包；认证中心账号由 shzw-xrain-auth 处理。
- [shzw-xrain-code-review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-code-review/SKILL.md)：审核 XRain 前后端、diff 或 PR；项目级审核追踪完整调用链，重复审核自动反思并补查。不用于纯方案评审。

## 常用开发参考

- [Workforce SDK 参考](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/workforce-sdk.md)：公开导出、客户端调用、执行上下文和交付版本。
- [业务 API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/business-api.md)：方法、路径、请求和响应。
- [建模](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/modeling.md)：对象、字段、关联与资源包。
- [对象基础](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/object-foundation.md)：系统字段、默认能力与业务增量。
- [数据操作](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/data-operations.md)：查询、统计、批量、并发及实际返回。
- [授权](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/authorization.md)：参与者、动作、字段、记录范围和执行主体。
- [业务实现](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/implementation.md)：公共宿主、页面、业务服务与 AI 工具。
- [系统集成](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/integration.md)：原系统复用、远端身份与失败恢复。
- [API 验证范围](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-workforce-business-development/references/api-verification.md)：日期、版本、具体实测与已知限制。
- [CLI 安装](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-cli/references/installation.md)：完整目录、运行前提与使用入口。
- [CLI 命令](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xingshukeji/skills-hub/main/skills/shzw-xrain-cli/references/commands.md)：已支持命令和参数。
